_doc: Kirigakure v2: the character wavers like a mirage and fades out (no mist puffs). Done with a shader on the character's sprite, so it works for every direction and animation, walking included.
how: give the character's Sprite2D a ShaderMaterial with this shader
on cast: tween the uniforms 'amount' and 'visibility' along 'enter' (linear between keys)
on time out / attack: tween along 'exit', then remove the material (or leave it at amount 0, visibility 1)
visibility_note: 0.3 lets the player still see themself. For an enemy's eyes the character is fully hidden (game logic).

veil.what: mist swirling round the body while it wavers away; two sheets so the mist wraps round the character
veil.follows_character: no: leave it where the jutsu was cast (it reads better if the player walks out of the mist)
